Play as Mono, a newborn Guardian tasked with restoring balance to a broken world by reuniting the four Emotions: Anger, Anxiety, Happiness and Sorrow. As the guardian spirit of the Emotions, Mono can use emotional powers to interact with the eccentric inhabitants of each world, soothe four rampaging Emotions, and help them regain their balance before the world unravels any further.

Guide Mono through a series of evocative worlds, using observation and emotional awareness to overcome environmental challenges and connect with the world around them. Through thoughtful platforming, puzzle-driven progression and empathetic encounters with characters, uncover a heartfelt story that explores the complicated but meaningful ways different emotions manifest in our lives.

Players can experience MONOWAVE’s first chapter on Steam, offering roughly one hour of gameplay. Set in World 1, “The Panic Jungle,” a realm consumed by anxiety, players will learn MONOWAVE’s core emotion-based mechanics and face the first boss encounter, offering a hands-on introduction to the game’s heartfelt world ahead of its September 16th launch.

games.name: PATLABOR the Case Files
games.summary:
Labors. The generic term for robots developed for industrial use. Widely adopted in construction and civil engineering, crimes involving Labors rapidly increased. The Metropolitan Police Department established the Special Vehicle Section 2 Patrol Labor Squadron to counter this threat. Thus the "Patlabor" was born.

Relive numerous iconic scenes from "Mobile Police Patlabor" in this home console 3D action game. Play from different perspectives - Main Missions as Special Vehicle Section 2, and Another Side Missions as their adversaries.

Over 20 Labors appear in the game Master everything from the Ingram to the Griffon and Type Zero Includes Simulator Mode where you can engage in shooting practice and Labor-vs-Labor combat.

games.name: PATLABOR the Case Files Original Soundtrack
Roman Sands RE:Build
games.summary:
Washed up on the shores of a timeless luxury retreat, you find yourself acquainted with its unhinged inhabitants. They await the day that the Sun will swallow the world. You are obligated to serve their whims. 

There's more to this place than meets the eye. Can you uncover your exit?

Roman Sands RE:Build is a delirium-charged journey into apocalypse which collides through visual novel, adventure, puzzle solving, horror, and survival simulation.

games.name: Trails in the Sky 2nd Chapter
games.summary: Turn the page on the explosive 2nd chapter of Nihon Falcom’s legendary Trails saga! Estelle Bright sets out on a new journey across Liberl to uncover the truth behind Joshua’s disappearance and defeat the sinister Ouroboros organization.

games.name: VHS Nights: The Tidy Up Shift
Woodo
games.summary:
Woodo is a cozy 3D puzzle game based on simple diorama assembly mechanics with a beautiful visual style. 

The game is a reminiscence of childhood memories playing with a tiny wooden constructor, immersing players in a peaceful, safe and creative world.

games.name: 100 Cats Lost in China 2 Find & Color

games.summary:
Flamecraft is a cozy, turn-based strategy board game for 1 to 5 players. 

Become a Flamekeeper and help artisan dragons and shopkeepers delight the townspeople with their craft.

Gather and manage resources, enchant the shops using artifacts, and magic your way to becoming the best Flamekeeper.

games.summary: Gather your allies. Eliminate Angels. Transform into a Magical Girl. Slay god. Kernel Hearts is a Multiplayer Co-Op Roguelike Action RPG about four magical girls and their attempt to save a world that's drowning in ashes

games.name: Sniper Dan
games.summary:
Sniper Dan is a ridiculous, family-friendly 3D Hidden Object game with a big twist. Use a high-powered sniper rifle to solve low-stakes problems. Scope the scene, spot the problem, and shoot the solution. No violence. Just wholesome chaos and good intentions!

You’re not hunting enemies. You’re hunting problems. Fixing rusty taps, machines behaving badly and even stop a thieving Pelican. Travel far and wide across lively 3D locations packed with visual jokes and silly situations as you help those in need. 

Can Dan and his trusty tool get the job done?

The Grinch 2: Saving Christmas
games.summary:
Every Who down in Who-ville is jingling, singing and celebrating. And guess who can’t wait to join them... the Grinch! Now, with a heart three sizes bigger, and a wish to show the Whos he’s changed, could the Grinch’s prize-winning tree be the perfect way to prove it?

Play as the Grinch and Jumbo-Jump through snowy 3D worlds, collecting ornaments to make your tree sparkle brighter with every step. Overcome platforming challenges, explore every nook and cranny, and use the clever gadgets you find to get through each level. Unleash the Snowball Maker to freeze mischievous adversaries, launch into action with the Rocket Skates, and reach new heights with the Jetpack.

Adventure solo or team up in local co-op mode. Together with Max, you’ll have fun outsmarting pesky mice, wild forest bats and other curious creatures. Uncover hidden paths and collect every sparkly decoration you can find to make your tree shine.

Make it a merry day in Who-ville, spread Christmas cheer, and create the most spectacular tree the Whos have ever seen!

games.name: The Walking Dead: Streets of Survival
games.summary: Fight walkers as Rick Grimes, Daryl Dixon and Michonne in a brutal arcade brawler set in the world of AMC’s The Walking Dead. Face ruthless enemies like the Saviors and overwhelming walker swarms as you unleash relentless combos, signature weapon attacks, and crushing finishers.

games.name: The Walking Dead: Streets of Survival - Arcade Apocalypse Pack
games.summary:
The Arcade Apocalypse Pack expands the brutal world of AMC’s The Walking Dead with exclusive digital content built for survivors ready to push deeper into the apocalypse.

Push your skills to the limit in Walker Pit - an Endless Survival Mode, where every encounter becomes a desperate battle to stay alive against overwhelming odds. For survivors looking for the ultimate challenge, “Hell on Earth” difficulty strips away checkpoints and leaves no room for mistakes.

Also included are additional weapon & character skins, and the digital soundtrack.

CONTROL Resonant
games.summary:
With Control, we leaped into the unknown. We wanted to create something new. Something different and unexpected. A world like no other. 

With Control 2, we'll take another leap into the unknown. It'll be an unexpected journey.

games.name: Silent Hill: Townfall
games.summary: SILENT HILL: Townfall, a co-production with Annapurna Interactive (Stray) and multiple BAFTA award winning No Code Studios (Stories Untold, Observation).

games.name: Gears of War: E-Day
games.summary:
Experience the brutal horror of Emergence Day through the eyes of Marcus Fenix in the origin story of one of gaming's most acclaimed sagas.​ 

Fourteen years before Gears of War, war heroes Marcus Fenix and Dom Santiago return home to face a new nightmare: the Locust Horde. These subterranean monsters, grotesque and relentless, erupt from below, laying siege on humanity itself. ​

Built from the ground up with Unreal Engine 5, Gears of War: E-Day delivers unprecedented graphical fidelity.

games.name: Castlevania: Belmont's Curse
games.summary:
1499. Paris is engulfed as monstrous creatures suddenly emerge from the shadows.

Armed with the legendary holy whip, the Vampire Killer, Trevor Belmont’s successor ventures into the burning streets and the looming castle to hunt down the beasts.

Will she succeed in saving Paris from devastation...?

Set 23 years after Castlevania Dracula's Curse - follow a young Belmont's journey in an all new 2D Action-Exploration title from KONAMI, Evil Empire and Motion Twin.

games.name: Final Fantasy Resonance
games.summary: Return to the pixel‑art world of FINAL FANTASY, evolved from its classic roots. Travel with companions bound by fate and call on Visions to aid you in battle to uncover the truth behind a force that threatens to bring everything to ruin.
